answer: Bonded-validator staking at the wharf: each identity must post collateral ≥ 5× expected epoch reward. Slashing burns 100% of bond on proven sybil linkage via shared funding graphs. Marginal cost per fake identity rises linearly while reward stays flat, so returns go negative past ~3 identities. Shale-hard evidence of collusion triggers automatic forfeiture. The inlet of cheap identities dries up once expected profit < bond loss, forcing attackers to burn capital faster than they earn.
